target_domain: Finance / Internal Audit / Risk Advisory (Pursuing US CPA)
incident_summary: SIS Industrial Trainee role passed Stage 1 and Stage 2 matching despite Job Highlights explicitly requiring Passed both groups of CA Intermediate and registered for ICAI industrial training.

root_causes.defect: Scraper extracted highlights_list from DOM but performed zero early filtering or negative keyword validation.
Stage 1 Gatekeeper negative keyword checks on JD body were gated behind overly restrictive prefix regexes.
Title Industrial Trainee fell back to transferable capability matching. Line 860 treated job highlights as duties header.
